comparison.objective: Extract a fitted collar using a prepared screw puller and recover both collar and tool; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record counterholds a puller while turning its screw, then parks the tool and collar. Candidate butts a jig to a rail and slides/regrasps a block without losing free balls.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires measured screw turns, collar removal and tray recovery, intact parked tool, clearance and stillness. Candidate requires complete block transfer and uninterrupted containment without damage or contamination.
comparison.reason: Screw-driven extraction and tool recovery are mechanically different from continuous bearing support transfer.
